items.text: fixed: in the zoomed film view the grid lines and marks inside the frame were soft while the lines outside it were crisp. The grid is now drawn at the zoomed size instead of being stretched, so both look the same.

fixed: in the zoomed film view the grid lines stay 1 px all the way through the zoom, in and out. The line width now follows the grid's size on every frame of the morph, so lines no longer start thin, or end thick, while the grid is growing or shrinking.

changed: the message that appears in the top corner no longer sits over anything: it ignores touches, stays for 3.5 seconds at most, and keeps out of the way while a panel is open or in the film view.

changed: the heads-up display no longer drifts sideways while you scroll it. A deliberate sideways flick turns to the next or previous pane (the same swipe Current's sheets use); a slanted scroll, a slider or a pad does not.
changed: the play-line pads (Way, Feel) now only preview while your finger moves, and the line changes when you lift. Sliding across planar and polar no longer makes the whole grid jump.
Mark size, under "Look of the effects" in Dice and air. One slider for how big the marks the sounds leave are (rain, ripples, bloom), remembered separately for a phone, a tablet and a computer.
changed: the heads-up display's close button is a drawn multiply sign (two crossing strokes) instead of a letter.
fixed: tapping a Motion setting no longer jumps the pane's scroll somewhere else; it stays where you are.
fixed: holding the crossfader motion button in the Mixer now takes you to the Motion section itself (flashing it), not just to the top of Lines and auto dice.

Motion in the Auto panel (Lines and auto dice, at the bottom). Set how the A|B crossfader moves: shape (sine, triangle, square, saw, smooth random, steps), length counted in beats, bars or minutes, how far it swings, and whether it loops or runs once and holds. Beats and bars follow the tempo while it plays, so a 16-bar swell stays in time at any BPM. Presets: Tide, Breath, Slow Seesaw, Phrase, Section and Rise (32 bars, once).
changed: the crossfader's motion button in the Mixer still taps through the presets; hold it to jump to the Motion settings.
fixed: on a phone the pane's name in the Form panel was cut off ("Lines and auto dic"). The name now gets the room it needs and the hint beside it gives way.
